evaluation.interval_method: 95% circular moving-block bootstrap of annual folds; block length ceil(sqrt(n_folds))

limitations: Query matches overlap and are not independent entity counts
Historical counts are current API snapshots, not vintage data available in the historical year
Only five domains; correlated years and no independent commercialization outcome dataset
Block-bootstrap intervals are descriptive with few annual folds; no significance claim
OpenAlex free-text query matches are broad activity proxies, not validated domain membership
